Purpose and principal workflow

This is a cross-tool library of AI-agent skill packages, instructions, personas, and stdlib CLI helpers rather than a single deployed application. A developer or AI coding agent initiates use by selecting a skill or running one of its local CLIs; the documented Agent Launcher workflow starts from a goal, routes it through managed-agent launch/iteration guidance, and emits BYOK scaffolding rather than making provider API calls. Independently, tools such as the RAG designer accept local requirements and produce design artifacts.

Components

**Agent lifecycle and orchestration**
- **Coding-tool user or AI agent** — null repository path; the external caller that activates installed skills or invokes their CLI tools.
- **Agent Launcher goal router** — `agent-launcher/skills/agent-launcher-orchestrator`; documented as the goal-based orchestrator for building, launching, grading, scheduling, and closing Claude Managed Agent work.
- **Agent Launcher lifecycle specialists** — `agent-launcher/skills`; contains the interview, stage-launch, grade-iterate, run-without-you, and wrap-up skill stages listed in the repository tree and README.
- **Claude Managed Agents account** — null repository path; the external target for launcher-produced BYOK scaffolds and deployment guidance.
- **AgentHub coordination suite** — `engineering/agenthub`; provides skills for hub initialization, spawning, running, merging, evaluation, and status/board operations.
- **Self-improving-agent suite** — `engineering-team/self-improving-agent`; packages memory extraction, review, promotion, status, and remembered-context workflows.
- **Agent-memory ladder** — `engineering/agent-memory`; provides hook-oriented multi-tier memory management and promotion guidance.

**Architecture and delivery design tools**
- **RAG design CLI** — `engineering/skills/rag-architect/rag_pipeline_designer.py`; parses a requirements JSON file and optionally saves a JSON pipeline-design result.
- **RAG synthesis engine** — `engineering/skills/rag-architect/rag_pipeline_designer.py`; determines scale and recommends chunking, embeddings, vector storage, retrieval, reranking, evaluation, architecture, templates, and monthly cost.
- **Backend decision engine** — `engineering-team/skills/senior-backend/scripts/backend_decision_engine.py`; ranks profile-based backend recommendations from operational, tenancy, sensitivity, and architecture constraints, including SLOs and approval criteria.
- **Frontend decision engine** — `engineering-team/skills/senior-frontend/scripts/frontend_decision_engine.py`; selects frontend/rendering profiles from device, Web Vitals, SEO, authentication, and team constraints.
- **Fullstack decision engine** — `engineering-team/skills/senior-fullstack/scripts/fullstack_decision_engine.py`; ranks complete-stack profiles while surfacing thresholds, approvers, ties, and kill criteria.
- **Data-pipeline configuration generator** — `engineering-team/skills/senior-data-engineer/scripts/pipeline_orchestrator.py`; generates, visualizes, and validates Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster pipeline configurations, including source/destination and schedule settings.
- **Engineering-team CI/CD scaffolder** — `engineering-team/skills/senior-devops/scripts/pipeline_generator.py`; detects Node, Python, Go, or generic projects and scaffolds GitHub Actions or CircleCI build/test/security/deploy stages.
- **Engineering CI/CD YAML generator** — `engineering/skills/ci-cd-pipeline-builder/scripts/pipeline_generator.py`; consumes a stack report or detects a repository stack, then emits GitHub or GitLab YAML and a summary.

**Data, ML, and revenue analysis helpers**
- **Computer-vision dataset pipeline builder** — `engineering-team/skills/senior-computer-vision/scripts/dataset_pipeline_builder.py`; analyzes dataset quality and annotations, converts COCO/YOLO/VOC formats, splits data, and produces augmentation configuration.
- **Feature-engineering pipeline scaffold** — `engineering-team/skills/senior-data-scientist/scripts/feature_engineering_pipeline.py`; exposes a configured CLI lifecycle and in-memory execution status, but its current `_execute` implementation is a placeholder.
- **Model-deployment pipeline scaffold** — `engineering-team/skills/senior-ml-engineer/scripts/model_deployment_pipeline.py`; similarly provides status handling and CLI parsing but currently has no substantive deployment implementation.
- **Revenue pipeline analyzer** — `business-growth/skills/revenue-operations/scripts/pipeline_analyzer.py`; reads SaaS deal-pipeline data and calculates coverage, conversion, velocity, aging, and concentration-risk metrics.

**Domain expertise packages**
- **Executive advisory skills** — `c-level-advisor/skills`; houses C-suite, board, strategic alignment, organizational-health, scenario, and company-operating-system advisory packages.
- **Founder-mode C-level agents** — `c-level-agents/skills`; contains persona reviews, boardroom, briefing, decision, execution, cross-evaluation, freeze, and office-hours workflows.
- **Business operations skills** — `business-operations/skills`; packages capacity planning, knowledge operations, process mapping, internal communications, procurement, and vendor-management guidance.
- **Commercial skills** — `commercial/skills`; packages pricing, deal desk, partnerships, channel economics, policy, RFP, and forecasting work.
- **Compliance operating system** — `compliance-os/skills`; groups readiness and audit-preparation workflows for AI Act, AIMS, FDA QSR, GDPR, ISO 13485/27001, SOC 2, and general compliance.
- **Playwright Pro toolkit** — `engineering-team/playwright-pro`; provides browser-test generation, review, migration, coverage, reporting, and BrowserStack/TestRail MCP integration packages.

Relationships

- **Coding-tool user or AI agent -> Agent Launcher goal router:** supplies a goal to begin the documented launcher workflow; README describes the orchestrator as a goal router.
- **Agent Launcher goal router -> Agent Launcher lifecycle specialists:** routes work among the documented interview, launch, grading/iteration, unattended-run, and wrap-up stages; exact runtime dispatch is not sampled.
- **Agent Launcher lifecycle specialists -> Claude Managed Agents account:** produce BYOK scaffolding and launch guidance for the caller’s account, rather than directly calling an API; README explicitly describes deterministic no-API scaffolders.
- **Coding-tool user or AI agent -> RAG design CLI:** invokes the CLI with a requirements file and optional output destination; `main()` parses those arguments.
- **RAG design CLI -> RAG synthesis engine:** loads requirements, constructs the designer, and calls `design_pipeline`.
- **RAG synthesis engine -> local filesystem:** writes the completed design only when an output path is supplied; the CLI calls `save_design`.
- **Coding-tool user or AI agent -> Backend decision engine:** supplies required deployment and system constraints to obtain a ranked recommendation.
- **Coding-tool user or AI agent -> Frontend decision engine:** supplies experience and performance constraints to obtain a rendering/framework recommendation.
- **Coding-tool user or AI agent -> Fullstack decision engine:** supplies team, cadence, traffic, budget, and sensitivity constraints to obtain a stack recommendation.
- **Coding-tool user or AI agent -> Data-pipeline configuration generator:** requests generation, visualization, or validation of pipeline definitions; it generates configuration/code for Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster rather than operating those systems.
- **Coding-tool user or AI agent -> Engineering-team CI/CD scaffolder:** selects a project and CI platform; the tool detects runtime markers and scaffolds pipeline configuration.
- **Coding-tool user or AI agent -> Engineering CI/CD YAML generator:** supplies stack JSON/stdin or a repository path, and the tool emits GitHub or GitLab YAML.
- **Computer-vision dataset pipeline builder -> Computer-vision dataset pipeline builder:** conversion auto-detects an unspecified source format by instantiating and running its dataset analyzer.
- **Coding-tool user or AI agent -> Revenue pipeline analyzer:** supplies JSON pipeline data or requests embedded sample analysis, receiving text or JSON health metrics.

Coverage limits

The sampled source establishes distributed local CLI entry points, not a shared runtime, plugin loader, provider client, database, queue, or network service. Most skill directories were not sampled, so their instruction contents, cross-skill routing, generated artifact formats, and installation/conversion implementation cannot be established beyond the README and tree organization.
